center	return ({ center("abc", 11), center("abcdef", 4), center("%^RED%^ab%^RESET%^", 10) });	({"   abc    ","abcdef","   %^RED%^ab%^RESET%^    "})
arrange_string	return ({ arrange_string("abc", 6), arrange_string("abcdefgh", 4) });	({"abc   ","abcd"})
trim	return ({ trim("  a b  "), trim("\tx\t"), trim("nospace") });	({"a b","x","nospace"})
space_trim	return space_trim("a  b   c    d");	"a b c d"
newline_trim	return newline_trim("\\n\\nab\\n\\n");	"ab"
wrap with width	return ({ wrap("the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog", 12), wrap("short", 20) });	({"the quick   \nbrown fox   \njumps over  \nthe lazy dog\n","short               \n"})
reverse_string	return ({ reverse_string("abc"), reverse_string("") });	({"cba",""})
starts_with	return ({ starts_with("abcdef", "abc"), starts_with("abcdef", "x"), starts_with_arr("abc", ({ "x", "ab" })) });	({1,0,0})
last first truncate	return ({ last("abcdef", 2), first("abcdef", 2), truncate("abcdef", 2) });	({"ef","ab","abcd"})
grepp memberp	return ({ grepp("hello world", "wor"), grepp("hello", "z"), memberp(({ 1, 2 }), 2), reverse_memberp("abc", ({ "x", "b" })) });	({1,0,1,1})
first last element	return ({ last_string_element("a/b/c", "/"), first_string_element("a/b/c", "/"), path_prefix("/a/b/c.c") });	({"c","a","/a/b"})
alpha numeric	return ({ alphap("abc"), alphap("ab1"), alpha_strip("a1b2-c"), numericp("123"), numericp("12a"), basic_punctuationp("."), basic_punctuationp("a") });	({1,0,"abc",1,1,1,0})
chunk_string	return ({ chunk_string("abcdefghij", 3), chunk_string("ab", 5) });	({({"abc","def","ghi","j"}),({"ab"})})
morse	return ({ morse("sos"), unmorse(morse("hello")) });	({"... --- ... ","hello "})
convert_string	return ({ convert_string("12"), convert_string("\\"str\\""), convert_string("({ 1, 2 })"), convert_string("([ \\"a\\" : 1 ])"), convert_string("-5"), convert_string("1.5") });	({12,"str",({1,2}),(["a":1]),-5,1})
convert_newline	return convert_newline("a\\nb");	"a\nb"
cleaned	return ({ cleaned_name("Bob the Great"), cleaned_end("hello!!!") });	({"Bob the Great",""})
add_article	return ({ add_article("apple"), add_article("sword"), add_article("sword", 1), add_article("hour"), add_article("Unicorn") });	({"an apple","a sword","the sword","a hour","an Unicorn"})
remove_article	return ({ remove_article("a sword"), remove_article("the apple"), remove_article("an egg"), remove_article("sword") });	({"sword","apple","egg","sword"})
explode_list	return ({ explode_list("a, b and c"), explode_list("x"), explode_list("one and two") });	({({"a","b","c"}),({"x"}),({"one","two"})})
item_list	return ({ item_list(({ "a sword" })), item_list(({ "a sword", "a sword" })), item_list(({ "a sword", "a sword", "a sword" })) });	({"a sword","two swords","three swords"})
possessive	return ({ possessive_noun("Bob"), possessive_noun("Chris"), possessive_noun("it") });	({"Bob's","Chris'","it's"})
ds pluralize	return ({ pluralize("sword"), pluralize("box"), pluralize("a sword"), pluralize("mouse"), pluralize("bag of gold") });	({"swords","boxes","swords","mice","bags of gold"})
cardinal	return ({ cardinal(0), cardinal(1), cardinal(13), cardinal(42), cardinal(100), cardinal(1234), cardinal(-7) });	({"zero","one","thirteen","forty-two","one hundred","one thousand, two hundred and thirty-four","negative seven"})
conjunction	return ({ conjunction(({ "a" })), conjunction(({ "a", "b" })), conjunction(({ "a", "b", "c" })), conjunction(({ "a", "b", "c" }), "or") });	({"a","a, and b","a, b, and c","a, b, or c"})
consolidate	return ({ consolidate(1, "a sword"), consolidate(3, "a sword"), consolidate(2, "an apple"), consolidate(5, "the orc") });	({"a sword","three swords","two apples","five orcs"})
ordinalp	return ({ ordinalp("first"), ordinalp("third"), ordinalp("seventh"), ordinalp("sword") });	({1,1,1,0})
comma	return ({ comma(0), comma(999), comma(1000), comma(1234567), comma(-1234), comma("12345") });	({"0","999","1,000","1,234,567","-1,234",0})
atoi itoa	return ({ atoi("42"), atoi("x"), itoa(5), itoa("7") });	({42,0,"5","7"})
ordinal	return ({ ordinal(1), ordinal(2), ordinal(3), ordinal(4), ordinal(11), ordinal(12), ordinal(13), ordinal(21), ordinal(22), ordinal(101), ordinal(111) });	({"st","nd","rd","th","th","th","th","st","nd","st","st"})
percent	return ({ percent(1, 4), percent(3, 3), percent(0, 7), percent(1, 3) });	({F25.0,F100.0,F0.0,F33.3333})
bool_reverse	return ({ bool_reverse(0), bool_reverse(5) });	({1,0})
compare arrays	return ({ sizeof(scramble_array(({ 1, 2, 3, 4 }))), sort_array(scramble_array(({ 3, 1, 2 })), 1) });	({4,({1,2,3})})
mappings	return ({ sort_array(keys(add_maps(([ "a": 1 ]), ([ "b": 2 ]))), 1) });	({({"a","b"})})
absolute_value	return ({ absolute_value(-5), absolute_value(3), absolute_value(-2.5) });	({5,3,F2.5})
absolute_path	return ({ absolute_path("/a/b", "c"), absolute_path("/a/b", "../c"), absolute_path("/a/b", "/x/y"), absolute_path("/a/b", "./c/./d"), absolute_path("/", "z") });	({"/a/b/c","/a/c","/x/y","/a/b/./c/./d","/z"})
